seo.title: AI receptionist app for phone and desktop | Aibooking.dk
seo.description: See calls, bookings, recordings and usage from your AI receptionist in one app on phone and desktop. One login everywhere, nothing to install.
seo.keywords: AI receptionist app, booking app, AI answering service app, AI booking overview, call log app, AI receptionist dashboard, mobile web app

hero.title: Your calls and bookings at a glance – in your pocket
hero.subtitle: See who called, what they wanted and what the AI receptionist booked. All in one simple app that works on your phone, tablet and computer with the same login.

phones.title: Built for busy days, not for IT people
phones.subtitle: There's no new system to learn. Open the app between two customers and within seconds you see today's calls, new bookings and who to call back.

items.caption: Today's numbers at the top: conversations, bookings and minutes left on your plan.
items.alt: The Aibooking app on a phone: the start screen with the business name, period picker and plan details

items.caption: Key figures in large, clear cards that are easy to read on a small screen.
items.alt: The Aibooking app on a phone: key figures for conversations, talk time, bookings, conversion and usage

items.caption: A simple menu with everything in one place: agents, knowledge base, statistics and integrations.
items.alt: The Aibooking app on a phone: the open menu with Overview, Agents, Knowledge base, Statistics and Integrations

benefits.title: Stop losing customers and get your time back
benefits.subtitle: The AI receptionist answers the phone and the chat. The app makes sure you always know what happened, so nothing slips through the cracks.

items.title: No customer lost to an unanswered call
items.desc: Every call and chat is logged with name, number and a short summary. You see straight away who needs a call back.

items.title: Spend your time on customers, not the phone
items.desc: No more listening to voicemail or writing down messages. Bookings, changes and cancellations are ready in the app, sorted and with the customer's name.

items.title: The overview in seconds
items.desc: Conversations, bookings, conversion and usage per day, week or month, per agent or in total. You see right away whether it pays off.

items.title: Hear exactly what was said
items.desc: Every conversation has a recording and a full transcript, so you can check an appointment or learn from a difficult call without asking the customer again.

screens.title: The same overview on the big screen
screens.subtitle: At the office or the front desk, open the app in your browser. These are the screens you'll use most.
screens.demo_note: The screenshots are from the real app, using a fictional hair salon as an example. Names and phone numbers are made up.

items.desc: The start screen shows your key figures for the selected period and a chart of conversations per day, split between phone and website.

install.title: Put the app on your home screen in a minute
install.subtitle: The app runs in the browser, so there's nothing to download from the App Store or Google Play. Log in once and add it to your home screen, and it opens like any other app.
install.image_alt: The Aibooking app login page on a phone with the 'Get the app on your phone' box
install.image_caption: Scan the QR code or go to app.aibooking.dk on your phone

related.text: The app is included in every plan and in the free trial. It shows the activity from both the AI answering service and the chatbot on your website.
